title: How to Reset Your Password
content: Users can reset their password via the login page by clicking Forgot Password.
resolution:
To reset your password:
1. Go to the login page at https://app.example.com/login
2. Click Forgot Password below the sign-in button
3. Enter the email address associated with your account
4. Check your inbox for a password reset link (valid for 24 hours)
5. Click the link and set a new password (min 8 characters, must include a number and special character)

If you don't receive the email within 5 minutes, check your spam folder. If the issue persists, our support team is here to help.

title: API Rate Limiting Policy
content: API rate limits are 1000 requests/minute for standard plans and 5000 for enterprise.
resolution:
Our API rate limits:
- Standard Plan: 1,000 requests per minute
- Professional Plan: 3,000 requests per minute
- Enterprise Plan: 5,000 requests per minute

If you're hitting 429s:
1. Implement exponential backoff in your retry logic
2. Cache responses where appropriate
3. Use bulk/batch endpoints instead of individual calls
4. Upgrade your plan for higher limits

Monitor current usage at https://app.example.com/api/usage

title: Billing Cycle and Invoice Questions
content: Billing cycles are monthly. Invoices are generated on the 1st of each month.
resolution:
Our billing process:
- Billing cycles run monthly; invoices generated on the 1st
- View and download invoices at https://app.example.com/billing
- Payment methods accepted: credit card, ACH, wire transfer (Enterprise only)
- Plan changes: prorated charges/credits applied automatically
- Refund requests handled within 5 business days

For specific billing inquiries or refund requests, our billing team will review the account and follow up within 1 business day.

title: Data Export and GDPR Requests
content: GDPR data export and deletion requests are processed within 30 days.
resolution:
Data privacy handling:

Data Export: Export anytime from Settings > Data > Export. Generates a ZIP with all data in JSON format.

GDPR Deletion Request: Submit to privacy@example.com. We will:
1. Acknowledge the request within 48 hours
2. Process the deletion within 30 days
3. Confirm completion via email

Data Retention: Default 12 months after account closure; immediate deletion available on request.

title: How to Change Your Email Address
content: Users can update their email address from the Account Settings page.
resolution:
To change the email address on your account:
1. Log in and go to Settings > Account > Profile
2. Click Edit next to your current email address
3. Enter your new email address
4. We'll send a verification link to the new address
5. Click the link to confirm the change (valid for 24 hours)

Important:
- You must have access to both the old and new email addresses during the transition
- All future notifications will be sent to the new address
- Your login credentials will update to use the new email
- If you no longer have access to the current email, contact support for manual verification

title: Integration Setup Guide
content: Integrations can be configured from the Settings > Integrations page.
resolution:
To set up an integration:
1. Navigate to Settings > Integrations
2. Select the integration you want to configure
3. Follow the provider-specific authorization flow
4. Configure webhook URLs and event subscriptions
5. Test the connection using the Send Test Event button

Available integrations: Slack, Microsoft Teams, GitHub, GitLab, PagerDuty, Datadog, and custom webhooks.

For API key generation: Settings > API > Generate New Key. Store it securely — we don't display keys after creation.

title: Known Issue: Dashboard Loading Slowly
content: There is a known performance issue with dashboards containing >50 widgets.
resolution:
We're aware of a performance issue affecting dashboards with more than 50 widgets. Engineering is actively working on a fix (target: next release).

Workarounds:
1. Reduce the number of widgets to under 50 per dashboard
2. Use date range filters to limit data queries
3. Try Lite Dashboard mode: Settings > Dashboard > Enable Lite Mode
4. Clear your browser cache and disable browser extensions

We apologize for the inconvenience. This fix is our top engineering priority.

title: Azure AD / Entra ID SSO Setup
content: Azure Active Directory (Entra ID) is supported as a SAML 2.0 SSO provider.
resolution:
To configure SSO with Azure AD (Entra ID):
1. In your Azure portal, go to Enterprise Applications and create a new Non-gallery application named 'Fluent Support'
2. Under Single sign-on, select SAML
3. Enter our SP entity ID: https://app.example.com/saml/metadata
4. Set the ACS URL to: https://app.example.com/saml/acs
5. Map claims: emailaddress -> user.mail, givenname -> user.givenname, surname -> user.surname
6. Download the Federation Metadata XML and upload it in our portal under Settings > SSO > Identity Providers > Add
7. Assign your users or groups to the application
8. Test with a single user before enforcing SSO workspace-wide

If the SAML assertion fails with 'invalid_audience', confirm the SP entity ID matches exactly. If users get provisioned but cannot access workspaces, check that the email claim in the assertion matches the user's account email.

title: OneLogin SAML SSO Setup
content: OneLogin is supported as a SAML 2.0 SSO provider through the generic SAML connector.
resolution:
To configure SSO with OneLogin:
1. In OneLogin, go to Applications > Add App > search for 'SAML Custom Connector (Advanced)'
2. Name it 'Fluent Support' and save
3. Under Configuration:
   - Audience (EntityID): https://app.example.com/saml/metadata
   - Recipient: https://app.example.com/saml/acs
   - ACS (Consumer) URL: https://app.example.com/saml/acs
4. Under Parameters, map: NameID -> Email, FirstName -> firstname, LastName -> lastname
5. Under SSO, copy the Issuer URL, SAML 2.0 Endpoint, and download the X.509 certificate
6. In our portal, go to Settings > SSO > Identity Providers > Add > Generic SAML 2.0 and paste the three values
7. Assign users or groups in OneLogin and test

For multi-tenant orgs, set the SSO domain restriction so only matching email domains use this connector.

title: MFA Device Recovery
content: MFA device recovery requires identity verification through backup codes or support assistance.
resolution:
If you have lost access to your authenticator app or 2FA device:

**Option 1 - Backup codes (fastest)**
1. Go to the login page and enter your email and password
2. On the MFA prompt, click 'Use a backup code'
3. Enter one of the 10 single-use backup codes you saved when MFA was enabled
4. Once logged in, go to Settings > Security > MFA and remove the old device
5. Re-enroll a new authenticator app and save fresh backup codes

**Option 2 - Support-assisted recovery**
1. Email mfa-recovery@example.com from the email address on your account
2. Include a clear photo of a government-issued ID matching the name on the account
3. Our security team verifies within 24 business hours
4. Once verified, we remove MFA and you can re-enroll

For SSO-enabled workspaces, MFA reset goes through your IdP admin, not through us. Reach out to your internal IT team first.

title: Plan Changes and Proration
content: Plan changes are prorated automatically based on the current billing cycle.
resolution:
To change your plan:
1. Go to Settings > Billing > Plan
2. Click 'Change plan' and pick the new tier
3. Review the proration preview before confirming

**How proration works:**
- Upgrades: charged immediately for the difference between the old and new plan, prorated for the remaining days in the cycle. The next full charge is at the next billing date at the new rate.
- Downgrades: take effect at the start of the next billing cycle. The current cycle continues at the existing rate; no refund is issued for the downgrade itself.
- Mid-cycle cancellation: prorates a refund only for prepaid annual plans. Monthly plans run to the end of the cycle.

If you upgraded by mistake within the last 24 hours, contact billing@example.com and we can reverse the upgrade and refund the prorated charge.

title: Role and Permission Management
content: Workspace roles are Admin, Member, and Viewer; custom roles are available on Enterprise plans.
resolution:
To change a user's role:
1. Go to Settings > Members > pick the user > Change role
2. Select Admin, Member, or Viewer
3. The change applies immediately

**Default role permissions:**
- Admin: full workspace access, billing, SSO, member management, API keys
- Member: create and edit tickets, view dashboards, use integrations
- Viewer: read-only access to tickets and dashboards; cannot edit

**Custom roles (Enterprise):**
1. Go to Settings > Roles > New role
2. Name the role and pick the granular permissions
3. Common patterns: Billing-only (just the billing surface), Compliance-only (audit logs and exports), Read-and-comment (Viewer + comment ability)

Workspace owner (the original creator) cannot be demoted; ownership transfer must go through Settings > Workspace > Transfer ownership.

title: OAuth Application Setup
content: Register OAuth 2.0 applications under Settings > Developer > OAuth applications.
resolution:
To register an OAuth 2.0 application:
1. Go to Settings > Developer > OAuth applications > New application
2. Name your app and add a redirect URI (must be exact, including https:// and any path)
3. Pick the scopes you need: tickets:read, tickets:write, users:read, users:write, integrations:manage
4. Save and copy the client_id; click 'Generate secret' to get the client_secret (shown once - store securely)

**Authorization code flow:**
1. Redirect users to: https://app.example.com/oauth/authorize?client_id=...&redirect_uri=...&scope=tickets:read&state=...
2. After approval, the user is redirected to your redirect_uri with ?code=... 
3. Exchange the code at POST https://app.example.com/oauth/token with client_id, client_secret, code, redirect_uri
4. Receive access_token (1-hour TTL) and refresh_token
5. Use the access_token in Authorization: Bearer ... headers on API calls

For PKCE flow (recommended for SPAs), omit the client_secret and include code_challenge plus code_verifier.

title: GitHub Integration Setup
content: The GitHub integration installs as a GitHub App on selected repositories.
resolution:
To connect a GitHub repository:
1. Go to Settings > Integrations > GitHub > Install
2. You are redirected to GitHub. Authorize the Fluent Support app and pick the repositories to expose - either all or specific repos
3. Back in our portal, the repos appear under Settings > Integrations > GitHub. Map each ticket category to one or more repos

**What the integration does:**
- Auto-links tickets to commits and PRs that mention the ticket ID
- Posts a comment on the PR when the ticket is updated and on the ticket when the PR merges
- Lets escalated tickets auto-create a GitHub issue with reproduction steps and severity

**Permissions requested:**
- Read access to issues, pull requests, and metadata
- Write access to issues (only if auto-create-issue is enabled)
- We do not request write access to code or branches

If the auto-link is not working, check that ticket IDs in commit messages match the format TKT-12345 exactly.

title: Custom Domain Configuration
content: Custom domains are supported for help-center pages and customer-facing portals on Pro and Enterprise plans.
resolution:
To configure a custom domain:
1. Go to Settings > Custom domains > Add domain
2. Enter your subdomain, for example support.yourcompany.com
3. We display a CNAME record to add to your DNS provider:
   support.yourcompany.com -> custom-domain.app.example.com
4. Add the CNAME and wait 5 to 60 minutes for DNS propagation
5. Click Verify in our portal. Once verified, we issue a Let's Encrypt certificate automatically (renews every 90 days)
6. Set the domain as the default by clicking 'Set as primary'

**Common pitfalls:**
- Apex domains (yourcompany.com without a subdomain) are not supported because CNAMEs cannot be used at the apex. Use a subdomain instead.
- If you use Cloudflare, set the proxy to DNS-only (gray cloud) for the verification CNAME, then switch to proxied (orange cloud) once verified if you want Cloudflare's edge.
- Wildcard subdomains and per-team subdomains are Enterprise-only features.
